```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

archive_url = "https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/archivepix.html"
html = requests.get(archive_url).text
soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
links = [a for a in soup.find_all('a') if a.get('href','').startswith('ap')]

# Collect entries for August 2015
aug_2015 = []
for a in links:
    href = a['href']
    text = a.get_text()
    if '2015' in href and 'Aug' in text:
        aug_2015.append((text, href))

# Fetch August 1–7 pages and look for mentions of city lights
results = []
for text, href in aug_2015:
    # text format: '2015 August X'
    try:
        day = int(text.split()[-1])
    except:
        continue
    if 1 <= day <= 7:
        page = requests.get('https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/' + href).text
        psoup = BeautifulSoup(page, 'html.parser')
        title = psoup.find('b').get_text(strip=True)
        desc = psoup.find_all('p')[-1].get_text(" ", strip=True)
        if 'horizon' in desc.lower() or 'city lights' in desc.lower():
            results.append({
                'date': text,
                'href': href,
                'title': title,
                'desc': desc[:300] + ('...' if len(desc)>300 else '')
            })

for r in results:
    print(r['date'], r['title'])
    print('Snippet:', r['desc'])
    print('URL:', 'https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/' + r['href'])
    print('---')
```
